action: Inspected only the pinned ClientLifecycleMode::Discover startup path and its direct discover_startup request/metadata handling.
finding: At the pinned commit, serve_client_with_ct_inner obtains ClientInfo from service.get_info() and passes it by reference to discover_startup for ClientLifecycleMode::Discover. discover_startup builds RequestMetaObject::with_client_context using the candidate protocol version together with clones of client_info.client_info and client_info.capabilities, inserts that metadata into DiscoverRequest extensions, and sends the DiscoverRequest. On a compatible DiscoverResult it stores peer ClientRequestMetadata with the selected protocol version and clones of the same client_info and capabilities, then returns DiscoverOutcome::Modern. The successful Discover branch does not invoke legacy_startup or construct a follow-up InitializeRequest.
scope_guard: This establishes only source-level pass-through of ClientInfo/capabilities into DiscoverRequest metadata and stored post-discover ClientRequestMetadata at the named commit/path. It does not prove wire serialization, server-side interpretation, post-discover per-request metadata injection, runtime sampling execution, or end-to-end scheduled-Chat parity. Auto-mode fallback behavior is outside the positive scope except that it was not used for this finding.
